The dimension of a rate is:
```{mcq}
#| label: R-3-12
1. The dimension of the numerator (the quantity on top).
2. The dimension of the denominator (the quantity on the bottom).
3. The dimension of the numerator divided by the dimension of the denominator. [correct]
4. Rates do not have a dimension. [hint: Wrong. A rate is a quantity. Quantities *always* have a dimension!]
```
:::
